verdict.rationale: Proa documents modular, composable typed Rust components vendored into src/components/ and a generator-maintained route registry. Its WebContext gives every render typed access to request-scoped data, which works like context-based injection. However, nothing documents an actual dependency-injection system for wiring services into modules. Missing for 10: an explicit DI container or provider mechanism, documentation of module/service boundaries and injection patterns, and independent corroboration.
